audit.why: Karma owns levels 1-2 on Inner Flame range (950) vs Yi's 600 Alpha Strike; lane flips at 4-6 and hard at first on-hit item. Matches the packet chart and the 51.21% win rate over 453 games.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: All-in window text cited Mantra generically without the real numbers, and omitted that Mantra-W heals her.
audit.why: Mantra is 40/38/36/34s and Highlander is 85s — the concrete numbers make the commit window actionable, and Mantra-W's self-heal is a Grievous Wounds trigger.
audit.corrected: report[9].t rewritten with Highlander's 85s and Mantra-W's heal/anti-heal note.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Karma's root 'RQ root'. Her root is Focused Resolve (W), 675 range, 12s; Mantra empowers W to extend the root and heal her. Mantra-Q is a delayed cataclysm, not a root. The page also claimed Wuju Style's true damage 'chews through her shields' — true damage ignores resistances, not shields.
audit.why: Riot's own text: W creates a tether that roots 'if the tether is not broken'; Mantra Bonus on W heals and extends. Q's Mantra bonus is a delayed area detonation with no root. Alpha Strike blinks 600 units untargetable, which is the tool that breaks the 675 tether.
audit.corrected: focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t all renamed to Focused Resolve (W) with the 675 range / 12s cooldown, and the shield claim corrected. Also recorded: Meditate is a channel and her root cancels it — do not sit in W while Focused Resolve is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers on the punish window.
audit.why: Focused Resolve 12s flat and Mantra 40s at rank 1 are the two clocks that decide when Yi can commit; Alpha Strike's 20s at rank 1 is reduced by basic attacks.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: Meditate is flagged as a channel; her root interrupts it, so sustaining through poke while her W is up throws away the heal and the mana.

edits.before: Her Mantra-empowered RQ root — it's the one ability that can pin me down out of Alpha Strike for her jungler or her own follow-up. Bait it or save Alpha Strike to break the tether, and the rest of her kit can't stop me.
edits.after: Her root is Focused Resolve (W), 675 range on a 12s cooldown — Mantra extends it and heals her off it. It only fires if the tether holds, so Alpha Strike out past her 675 range and it breaks before it ever roots me.

edits.before: Track her Mantra (R) charge — Mantra-Q is the empowered poke/burst that actually hurts, and RQ root is the only thing that can pin me out of Alpha Strike. Bait or wait out her R before committing.
edits.after: Track her Mantra (R), 40s at rank 1 — empowered Q is the delayed poke that actually hurts, and Mantra-W is the extended root plus a self-heal. Focused Resolve alone is 12s, so commit once Mantra is spent.

edits.before: Alpha Strike makes you untargetable mid-blink — time it to dodge her RQ root or any jungler CC, then commit. It's your only escape, so don't waste it pushing the wave when she has Mantra up.
edits.after: Alpha Strike is untargetable mid-blink and carries you 600 units — use it to leave Focused Resolve's 675 tether so the root never fires, then commit. Basic attacks cut its 20s cooldown, so keep farming.

edits.before: Blinking in while she has Mantra means she RQ-roots you the second you're targetable again and her jungler collapses. Only commit when her root is on cooldown or baited.
edits.after: Blinking in while Mantra is up means Mantra-W roots you for longer and heals her off the tether while her jungler collapses. Commit once Focused Resolve's 12s is down or baited.

edits.before: Alpha Strike makes me untargetable while blinking, so it dodges her RQ root and tether on reaction — the single most important interaction in the lane. Wuju Style's true damage ignores any defensive stat and chews through her shields; Meditate out-sustains her Q poke; Highlander's slow immunity ignores her E speed-peel so I stick to her.
edits.after: Alpha Strike blinks 600 units untargetable, so it carries me out of Focused Resolve's 675 tether before the root lands — the key interaction of the lane. Wuju Style's true damage ignores resistances, but Inspire's shield still eats it; Meditate is a channel her root cancels, so only sit in it once her W is spent.

edits.before: My real all-in windows open at level 6 with Highlander and become reliable at my first on-hit item. Commit only when her Mantra (R) is down — that's when she has no root to pin me and no empowered burst to trade back.
edits.after: My all-in windows open at level 6 with Highlander's 85s of slow immunity and get reliable at my first on-hit item. Go when Mantra is spent: Mantra-W is the long root and the self-heal, so Grievous Wounds pays off in every extended fight.

edits.before: Karma's empowered Q and root still control level 2.
edits.after: Her empowered Q and Focused Resolve own level 2.

notes: Systematic naming error across this matchup: the page called Karma's root 'RQ root' in six places. The root is Focused Resolve (W); Mantra-W extends it and heals her. Also corrected the false claim that true damage bypasses shields. Level chart agrees with the packet and needs no change.
